name: Bubble Pop Valhalla
author: Addicting Games
description: Bubble Pop is a free clicker game. Pop the bubbles it's nothing new, in groups of three or maybe two, if the colors you cannot see then use the logos to guide your tapping spree. Bubble Pop is a game that challenges your ability to see patterns, smash them, and pivot to the next challenge. Each correctly popped set of bubbles will inherently alter the playing field and in doing so the game will be altered irrevocably. This is not the end of the world for those that have the ability to see ahead. The true masters of this game are the people who are able to see 3 potential pops and optimize which cluster they'll bust by pre-determining the outcome of the pop and thinking one move, two moves, even three moves ahead. If you feel overwhelmed by problems stacking up without a solution site then you'll love this game where every obstacle can be popped and disposed of without nary a thought. Challenge your friends, defeat your enemies, the world is yours all yours, so long as you are able to play along and devastate the competition. Do you feel like you have what it takes to make it all the way to Bubble Pop Valhalla? Then prove it with the tips of your fingers and the skin of your teeth in this thrilling new bubble popping bonanza.
